description:
Create a **parametric insurance policy** on the FoundryNet devnet program.

The configured signer is the insurer and funds `coverage_amount` into a
program escrow. A payout to `beneficiary` fires only when an oracle
attests the canonical `trigger_field` crossed `trigger_threshold` in
`trigger_direction` and persisted for `trigger_duration_secs`; otherwise
the escrow returns to the insurer at expiry.

beneficiary.description: base58 pubkey that receives the payout (the machine owner).

coverage_amount.description: SPL base-unit payout the insurer escrows.

machine.description: optional registered machine pubkey (defaults to the signer).

premium_amount.description: SPL base-unit monthly premium the operator pays.

trigger_duration_secs.description: how long the condition must persist (default 60).

name: mint_create_policy
title: Mint Create Policy
